"""Bounded-run external distinct counts. Python 3.12, standard library only.
Input: ASCII video_id<TAB>user_id<TAB>view|click, no header; final LF optional.
The two ID fields match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}. Output is per-video distinct users.
"""
from contextlib import ExitStack
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import heapq
import os
import re
import tempfile

ID = re.compile(rb"[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}\Z")
MAX_LINE = 300


def rows(stream):
    while True:
        line = stream.readline(MAX_LINE + 1)
        if not line:
            return
        if len(line) > MAX_LINE:
            raise ValueError("line too long")
        if line.endswith(b"\n"):
            line = line[:-1]
        if line.endswith(b"\r"):
            line = line[:-1]
        fields = tuple(line.split(b"\t"))
        if (len(fields) != 3 or not ID.fullmatch(fields[0])
                or not ID.fullmatch(fields[1]) or fields[2] not in (b"view", b"click")):
            raise ValueError("expected video<TAB>user<TAB>view|click")
        yield fields


def write_unique(records, destination):
    previous = None
    with destination.open("wb") as out:
        for row in records:
            if row != previous:
                out.write(b"\t".join(row) + b"\n")
                previous = row


def count_users(source, output, work_parent, chunk_rows=50_000, fan_in=32):
    source, output, work_parent = map(Path, (source, output, work_parent))
    if source.resolve() == output.resolve():
        raise ValueError("input and output must differ")
    if chunk_rows <= 0 or not 2 <= fan_in <= 64:
        raise ValueError("positive chunk_rows; fan_in in [2,64]")
    staged = None
    try:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="video-runs-", dir=work_parent) as name:
            work = Path(name)
            def run(level, index):
                return work / f"l{level}-r{index}.tsv"
            count, chunk = 0, []
            with source.open("rb") as inp:
                for row in rows(inp):
                    chunk.append(row)
                    if len(chunk) == chunk_rows:
                        chunk.sort()
                        write_unique(chunk, run(0, count))
                        count += 1
                        chunk.clear()
                if chunk:
                    chunk.sort()
                    write_unique(chunk, run(0, count))
                    count += 1
            level = 0
            # Only counters and one fan-in batch of paths are resident, not all run paths.
            while count > 1:
                next_count = 0
                for begin in range(0, count, fan_in):
                    group = [run(level, i) for i in range(begin, min(begin + fan_in, count))]
                    with ExitStack() as stack:
                        inputs = [rows(stack.enter_context(p.open("rb"))) for p in group]
                        write_unique(heapq.merge(*inputs), run(level + 1, next_count))
                    for p in group:
                        p.unlink()
                    next_count += 1
                count, level = next_count, level + 1
            # Stage beside the output so replace does not cross filesystems.
            fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".video-result-", dir=output.parent)
            staged = Path(temporary)
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as out:
                out.write(b"video_id\tview_users\tclick_users\n")
                video, views, clicks = None, 0, 0
                if count:
                    with run(level, 0).open("rb") as inp:
                        for v, _u, action in rows(inp):
                            if video is not None and v != video:
                                out.write(video + f"\t{views}\t{clicks}\n".encode("ascii"))
                                views, clicks = 0, 0
                            video = v
                            views += action == b"view"
                            clicks += action == b"click"
                    if video is not None:
                        out.write(video + f"\t{views}\t{clicks}\n".encode("ascii"))
                out.flush()
                os.fsync(out.fileno())
            os.replace(staged, output)
            staged = None
    finally:
        if staged is not None:
            staged.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def self_test():
    import random
    rng = random.Random(20261012)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
        root = Path(name)
        source, output = root / "in.tsv", root / "out.tsv"
        data = [(f"v{rng.randrange(7)}".encode(), f"u{rng.randrange(19)}".encode(),
                 rng.choice([b"view", b"click"])) for _ in range(800)]
        data += [(b"v0", b"u0", b"view")] * 90
        rng.shuffle(data)
        expected = {}
        for v, u, action in data:
            expected.setdefault(v, {b"view": set(), b"click": set()})[action].add(u)
        oracle = b"video_id\tview_users\tclick_users\n" + b"".join(
            v + f"\t{len(a[b'view'])}\t{len(a[b'click'])}\n".encode()
            for v, a in sorted(expected.items()))
        source.write_bytes(b"\n".join(b"\t".join(row) for row in data))
        checks = 0
        for chunk in [1, 7, 101, 2000]:
            for fan in [2, 3, 32]:
                count_users(source, output, root, chunk, fan)
                assert output.read_bytes() == oracle
                checks += 1
        source.write_bytes(b"")
        count_users(source, output, root, 2, 2)
        assert output.read_bytes() == b"video_id\tview_users\tclick_users\n"
        checks += 1
        for invalid in [b"v\tu\tlike\n", b"v\t\tview\n", b"x" * 301,
                        b"v\tu\tview\textra\n", b"v\t\xff\tview\n"]:
            source.write_bytes(invalid)
            output.write_bytes(b"previous-success")
            try:
                count_users(source, output, root, 1, 2)
            except ValueError:
                pass
            else:
                raise AssertionError("invalid accepted")
            assert output.read_bytes() == b"previous-success"
            assert not list(root.glob("video-runs-*"))
            checks += 1
        print(f"PASS {checks} external distinct/oracle and failure checks; no 10TB benchmark")

几十GB的ID文件，禁止Redis/Kafka等中间件，JVM如何去重导出

流式读取、有界块内排序去重、磁盘多路归并、原子发布导出文件，可以在不把全文件载入JVM的条件下完成全局精确去重。

也可能这样问：唯一索引为什么能去重？Set为什么可以？不能用中间件怎么办？核心是解析内容而不是保存上传文件，流程如何安排？

数据库唯一索引以规定的键相等/排序规则拒绝重复值，适合允许数据库且需要事务查询的方案；要注意NULL、大小写/字符排序规则和批量冲突处理。HashSet通过hash定位再用equals区分碰撞，不是“hash相同就同一ID”；内存容得下时方便，几十GB文件不保证能容下其字符串、哈希表与对象开销。分块HashSet后直接拼文件只保证块内唯一，不能解决跨块重复。

本地外排不依赖Redis、Kafka或远程数据库。上传端流式写入受配额的临时文件/解析任务，由有界worker处理；若只需解析，可边接收边产出初始runs，待输入完整且校验通过才发布结果。不能每收到一块就把部分“最终导出”暴露为全部完成。需要重试时保存源快照/阶段manifest，或要求客户端重新上传；仅内存队列不能承诺宕机不丢。

以下Java21实现按字符串字典序输出，保留0001与1的差异。若ID是数值且二者等价，必须在解析层明确归一化与溢出规则；不能改变合同后仍用这个oracle。ID格式/最大长度固定，使BufferedReader.readLine可能遇到恶意超长行的内存风险被有界解析器消除。实现每轮只打开至多fanIn个文件，完成一组合并后删除其输入；输入快照和临时空间仍是前提。

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** No middleware. ASCII ID per line, 1..128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9_-]. */
public final class ExternalIdDedup {
    private ExternalIdDedup() {}
    // Package-private seam for deterministic read/close fault injection; public API is unchanged.
    interface IdInput extends Closeable { String next() throws IOException; }
    @FunctionalInterface interface InputFactory { IdInput open(Path path) throws IOException; }
    private static final class Lines implements IdInput {
        final InputStream in;
        Lines(Path p) throws IOException { in = new BufferedInputStream(Files.newInputStream(p)); }
        public String next() throws IOException {
            byte[] bytes = new byte[128]; int n = 0, c;
            while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && c != '\n' && c != '\r') {
                boolean valid = c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'
                        || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '_' || c == '-';
                if (!valid || n == bytes.length) throw new IOException("invalid/oversized ID");
                bytes[n++] = (byte)c;
            }
            if (c == '\r' && in.read() != '\n') throw new IOException("CR must be followed by LF");
            if (n == 0) {
                if (c == -1) return null;
                throw new IOException("empty ID");
            }
            return new String(bytes, 0, n, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        }
        public void close() throws IOException { in.close(); }
    }
    private static Path run(Path dir, int level, long index) {
        return dir.resolve("l" + level + "-r" + index + ".txt");
    }
    private static BufferedWriter writer(Path p) throws IOException {
        return Files.newBufferedWriter(p, StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
    }
    private static void chunk(List<String> values, Path out) throws IOException {
        Collections.sort(values); String previous = null;
        try (BufferedWriter w = writer(out)) {
            for (String value : values) if (!value.equals(previous)) {
                w.write(value); w.write('\n'); previous = value;
            }
        }
    }
    private record Head(String value, int source) {}
    /** Runs only bounded, caller-owned cleanup actions; never suppress an exception onto itself. */
    static void cleanup(Throwable primary, Closeable... resources) throws IOException {
        Throwable failure = primary;
        for (Closeable resource : resources) {
            try { resource.close(); }
            catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error closing) {
                if (failure == null) failure = closing;
                else if (failure != closing) failure.addSuppressed(closing);
            }
        }
        if (primary == null && failure != null) {
            if (failure instanceof IOException io) throw io;
            if (failure instanceof RuntimeException runtime) throw runtime;
            if (failure instanceof Error error) throw error;
            throw new AssertionError("unexpected cleanup exception type", failure);
        }
    }
    private static void merge(List<Path> group, Path out) throws IOException {
        merge(group, out, Lines::new);
    }
    static void merge(List<Path> group, Path out, InputFactory factory) throws IOException {
        List<IdInput> inputs = new ArrayList<>();
        Throwable primary = null;
        try (BufferedWriter w = writer(out)) {
            PriorityQueue<Head> q = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparing(Head::value)
                    .thenComparingInt(Head::source));
            for (Path p : group) {
                IdInput reader = factory.open(p); inputs.add(reader);
                String value = reader.next();
                if (value != null) q.add(new Head(value, inputs.size() - 1));
            }
            String previous = null;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                Head h = q.remove();
                if (!h.value.equals(previous)) { w.write(h.value); w.write('\n'); previous = h.value; }
                String value = inputs.get(h.source).next();
                if (value != null) q.add(new Head(value, h.source));
            }
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error e) { primary = e; throw e; }
        finally { cleanup(primary, inputs.toArray(Closeable[]::new)); }
    }
    private static void clean(Path dir) throws IOException {
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> entries = Files.newDirectoryStream(dir)) {
            for (Path entry : entries) Files.deleteIfExists(entry);
        }
        Files.deleteIfExists(dir);
    }
    public static void deduplicate(Path input, Path output, Path workParent,
                                   int chunkRows, int fanIn) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(input); Objects.requireNonNull(output); Objects.requireNonNull(workParent);
        if (chunkRows <= 0 || chunkRows > 1_000_000 || fanIn < 2 || fanIn > 64)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("bounded chunkRows and fanIn 2..64 required");
        if (input.toAbsolutePath().normalize().equals(output.toAbsolutePath().normalize())
                || Files.exists(output) && Files.isSameFile(input, output))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("input and output must differ");
        Path parent = output.toAbsolutePath().getParent();
        Path work = Files.createTempDirectory(workParent, "id-runs-");
        Path staged = null; Throwable primary = null;
        try {
            List<String> values = new ArrayList<>(chunkRows); long count = 0;
            try (Lines in = new Lines(input)) {
                String value;
                while ((value = in.next()) != null) {
                    values.add(value);
                    if (values.size() == chunkRows) {
                        chunk(values, run(work, 0, count++)); values.clear();
                    }
                }
                if (!values.isEmpty()) chunk(values, run(work, 0, count++));
            }
            values.clear(); int level = 0;
            while (count > 1) {
                long next = 0;
                for (long first = 0; first < count; first += fanIn) {
                    List<Path> group = new ArrayList<>(fanIn);
                    for (long i = first; i < Math.min(count, first + fanIn); i++) group.add(run(work, level, i));
                    merge(group, run(work, level + 1, next++));
                    for (Path p : group) Files.delete(p);
                }
                count = next; level++;
            }
            staged = Files.createTempFile(parent, ".id-result-", ".txt");
            if (count == 1) Files.copy(run(work, level, 0), staged, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            try (FileChannel channel = FileChannel.open(staged, StandardOpenOption.WRITE)) { channel.force(true); }
            // Fail rather than silently weaken atomic publication if this filesystem cannot do it.
            Files.move(staged, output, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
            staged = null;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error e) { primary = e; throw e; }
        finally {
            Path abandoned = staged;
            cleanup(primary,
                    () -> { if (abandoned != null) Files.deleteIfExists(abandoned); },
                    () -> clean(work));
        }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        if (args.length != 3) throw new IllegalArgumentException("INPUT OUTPUT WORK_DIRECTORY");
        deduplicate(Path.of(args[0]), Path.of(args[1]), Path.of(args[2]), 50_000, 32);
    }
}

独立测试与失败边界

测试用完整TreeSet作小数据oracle，但主实现从未依赖全量Set；覆盖跨块重复、不同fan-in、多轮归并、前导零、空文件、CRLF/末行无换行、非法字符、超长行和失败不发布。这个测试不是几十GB吞吐测量，也不证明断电恢复；磁盘配额、源文件不可变、权限和校验manifest应由任务宿主保证。原子 move 若文件系统不支持会报错，不退化为半写文件；ATOMIC_MOVE 下已有目标能否替换由文件系统 provider 决定。文件 force 不等于父目录元数据的掉电耐久性。发布已成功而清理失败时可能报错，调用者应按结果文件身份核对，不盲目把它当从未发布。

清理失败怎样保留真正的主因

先保住真正导致任务失败的异常。输入读取、比较或归并已经失败时，关闭流和删除暂存文件的错误只能作为 suppressed 附在原异常上；如果没有主异常，才抛第一个清理错误，并继续尝试其余清理。

还有一个容易漏掉的分支：同一异常对象不能附到自己身上，否则 addSuppressed 又会抛错，反而遮住主因。实现把受限的 Closeable 清理动作集中处理，分别保留 IOException、RuntimeException 和 Error，避免遗漏未检查异常。读后面的注入测试时，逐项检查主异常身份及其附加错误。

下面通过包内InputFactory测试入口向真实merge循环注入读错误和关闭错误，覆盖相同对象、不同对象、没有主异常、打开第二个输入失败及全部已打开输入都尝试关闭。该测试入口不改变对外deduplicate接口，也不替换分块排序或多路归并算法；原有13项外部排序语义测试继续运行。它不承诺虚拟机已无法分配内存或进程被强杀时还能完成清理。

import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public final class ExternalIdDedupCleanupTest {
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean ok) { checks++; if (!ok) throw new AssertionError("check " + checks); }
    private static void raise(Throwable t) throws IOException {
        if (t instanceof IOException io) throw io;
        if (t instanceof RuntimeException runtime) throw runtime;
        if (t instanceof Error error) throw error;
        if (t != null) throw new AssertionError("unsupported fixture", t);
    }
    private static ExternalIdDedup.IdInput input(String first, Throwable readFailure,
                                                Throwable closeFailure, AtomicInteger closed) {
        return new ExternalIdDedup.IdInput() {
            private boolean supplied;
            public String next() throws IOException {
                if (!supplied) { supplied = true; return first; }
                raise(readFailure); return null;
            }
            public void close() throws IOException { closed.incrementAndGet(); raise(closeFailure); }
        };
    }
    private static void helperChecks() throws IOException {
        IOException same = new IOException("same"); AtomicInteger actions = new AtomicInteger();
        ExternalIdDedup.cleanup(same, () -> { throw same; }, actions::incrementAndGet);
        check(same.getSuppressed().length == 0); check(actions.get() == 1);
        RuntimeException primary = new IllegalStateException("primary");
        IOException close1 = new IOException("close1"), close2 = new IOException("close2");
        ExternalIdDedup.cleanup(primary, () -> { throw close1; }, () -> { throw close2; });
        check(Arrays.equals(primary.getSuppressed(), new Throwable[]{close1, close2}));
        try {
            ExternalIdDedup.cleanup(null, () -> { throw same; }, () -> { throw same; },
                    () -> { throw close1; }, actions::incrementAndGet);
            throw new AssertionError("missing cleanup failure");
        } catch (IOException caught) {
            check(caught == same); check(Arrays.equals(caught.getSuppressed(), new Throwable[]{close1}));
        }
        check(actions.get() == 2);
        for (Throwable failure : List.of(new IllegalArgumentException("close"), new AssertionError("close"))) {
            try { ExternalIdDedup.cleanup(null, () -> raise(failure)); throw new AssertionError("missing"); }
            catch (RuntimeException | Error caught) { check(caught == failure); }
        }
        ExternalIdDedup.cleanup(null, actions::incrementAndGet); check(actions.get() == 3);
        ExternalIdDedup.cleanup(null); check(true);
    }
    private static void mergeChecks(Path root) throws IOException {
        Path a = Path.of("a"), b = Path.of("b"); Path out = root.resolve("merged.txt");
        // Fail only after both readers were registered and the real merge loop wrote its first ID.
        for (Throwable primary : List.of(new IOException("read"), new IllegalStateException("read"), new AssertionError("read"))) {
            AtomicInteger closed = new AtomicInteger(); IOException close1 = new IOException("close1"), close2 = new IOException("close2");
            try {
                ExternalIdDedup.merge(List.of(a,b), out, path -> path.equals(a)
                        ? input("a", primary, close1, closed) : input("b", null, close2, closed));
                throw new AssertionError("expected read failure");
            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error caught) {
                check(caught == primary);
                check(Arrays.equals(caught.getSuppressed(), new Throwable[]{close1,close2}));
            }
            check(closed.get() == 2); check(Files.readString(out).equals("a\n"));
        }
        // The exact same IOException instance is thrown from read and both close methods.
        IOException same = new IOException("reused"); AtomicInteger closed = new AtomicInteger();
        try {
            ExternalIdDedup.merge(List.of(a,b), out, path -> path.equals(a)
                    ? input("a", same, same, closed) : input("b", null, same, closed));
            throw new AssertionError("expected reused error");
        } catch (IOException caught) { check(caught == same); check(caught.getSuppressed().length == 0); }
        check(closed.get() == 2);
        // Successful merge followed by cleanup failures: first is thrown and second is suppressed.
        IOException c1 = new IOException("c1"), c2 = new IOException("c2"); closed.set(0);
        try {
            ExternalIdDedup.merge(List.of(a,b), out, path -> path.equals(a)
                    ? input("a", null, c1, closed) : input("b", null, c2, closed));
            throw new AssertionError("expected close failure");
        } catch (IOException caught) { check(caught == c1); check(Arrays.equals(caught.getSuppressed(), new Throwable[]{c2})); }
        check(Files.readString(out).equals("a\nb\n")); check(closed.get() == 2);
        // Failure opening a later reader must still close the already opened reader.
        closed.set(0); RuntimeException open = new IllegalArgumentException("open");
        IOException close = new IOException("close after open failure");
        try {
            ExternalIdDedup.merge(List.of(a,b), out, path -> {
                if (path.equals(b)) throw open;
                return input("a", null, close, closed);
            }); throw new AssertionError("expected open failure");
        } catch (RuntimeException caught) { check(caught == open); check(caught.getSuppressed()[0] == close); }
        check(closed.get() == 1);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        helperChecks(); Path root = Files.createTempDirectory("dedup-cleanup-test-");
        try { mergeChecks(root); }
        finally { try (var paths = Files.walk(root)) { for (Path p : paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList()) Files.delete(p); } }
        System.out.println("PASS " + checks + " cleanup checks: identity guards, first failure preservation, all cleanup attempted, IOException/RuntimeException/Error in actual merge loop and open failure; local fault injection only.");
    }
}

entryIdentity.title: 海量文件 Top K

records.before:
变体 1：内存只有 10MB 怎么办？

分析：如果 K=1000，堆本身很小，10MB 仍然够用；真正的问题是不能读全量数据。答案仍是流式读取 + 小顶堆。如果题目要求输出全量有序或 K 极大，则用外部排序：切分小文件、内存排序、落盘、多路归并。

变体 2：100 个文件大小极不均匀怎么办？

分析：按文件分配任务会导致大文件拖尾。答案是把大文件按块切分成更多任务，线程池从任务队列中动态取任务，最后归并所有分片 TopK。

变体 3：实时数据流中持续维护 TopK 怎么做？

分析：数据不会结束，不能等全量扫描。答案是维护一个长期小顶堆；如果多节点分布式处理，每个节点维护局部 TopK，定时汇总到中心节点或使用流处理框架做分层聚合。

手写版：

Answer.java
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public class LruCache<K, V> {
    private final int capacity;
    private final Map<K, Node<K, V>> map = new HashMap<>();
    private final Node<K, V> head = new Node<>(null, null);
    private final Node<K, V> tail = new Node<>(null, null);

    public LruCache(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        head.next = tail;
        tail.prev = head;
    }

    public V get(K key) {
        Node<K, V> node = map.get(key);
        if (node == null) {
            return null;
        }
        moveToHead(node);
        return node.value;
    }

    public void put(K key, V value) {
        Node<K, V> node = map.get(key);
        if (node != null) {
            node.value = value;
            moveToHead(node);
            return;
        }

        Node<K, V> created = new Node<>(key, value);
        map.put(key, created);
        addAfterHead(created);

        if (map.size() > capacity) {
            Node<K, V> removed = removeTail();
            map.remove(removed.key);
        }
    }

    private void moveToHead(Node<K, V> node) {
        remove(node);
        addAfterHead(node);
    }

    private void addAfterHead(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.prev = head;
        node.next = head.next;
        head.next.prev = node;
        head.next = node;
    }

    private void remove(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.prev.next = node.next;
        node.next.prev = node.prev;
    }

    private Node<K, V> removeTail() {
        Node<K, V> node = tail.prev;
        remove(node);
        return node;
    }

    private static class Node<K, V> {
        K key;
        V value;
        Node<K, V> prev;
        Node<K, V> next;

        Node(K key, V value) {
            this.key = key;
            this.value = value;
        }
    }
}

public class LruByLinkedHashMap<K, V> extends LinkedHashMap<K, V> {

entryIdentity.title: 手写 LRU 缓存

records.before:
严格手写、并发 TTL 与分布式 LRU 变体

原题平均 O(1) 的基本 LRU 与以下扩展分别保留契约：手写哈希桶与泛型同步版、统一写 TTL 且过期优先的 O(log n) 索引版、范围查询、分布式近似 LRU 和明确的教学 CLI 输入。TTL 版不是对原 O(1) 要求的同复杂度替换。

17 从普通 LRU 到泛型 并发 TTL 和分布式

手写 LRU 为什么同时需要哈希和双向链表

哈希索引负责按 key 定位节点，双向链表负责按最近访问顺序移动和淘汰；命中 get 和更新 put 都会改变访问顺序，因此线程安全版本的 get 也不是纯读操作。头部放最近使用项，尾部放最久未使用项，满容量插入时同时删除尾节点及其哈希映射。

如果明确禁止 LinkedHashMap，就不能用它隐藏链表实现。下面还把哈希桶自己实现出来，使严格手写变体也有完整答案；泛型键值均不接受 null，容量可以为零，get 未命中返回 null，evict(n) 删除最多 n 个尾节点并返回实际数量，负 n 抛错。

查找 O(1) 是散列分布合理时的期望复杂度，碰撞严重时可退化，不应宣称任意键都严格常数时间。桶内也维护前驱指针，已知尾节点的删除不必再次遍历碰撞链，所以 evict(n) 的结构修改是 O(min(n,size))。固定桶数组按容量预分配，避免访问过程中扩容；因此空间为 O(capacity)，不适合无上界容量或超大稀疏配置。

全局 synchronized 让哈希和访问链表保持一致，代价是同一缓存操作串行；键的 hashCode/equals 必须稳定、无重入副作用，返回的可变 value 仍由调用者管理。分段锁可以提高分区并发，但若每段独立淘汰，得到的是分段近似 LRU，不再是全局严格 LRU。

code/LruCache.java

code/LruCache.java
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/** Handwritten hash buckets + doubly linked access list; no LinkedHashMap/HashMap inside the cache. */
public final class LruCache<K, V> {
    private static final class Node<K, V> {
        final K key; final int hash; V value;
        Node<K, V> bucketPrevious, bucketNext, previous, next;
        Node(K key, V value, int hash) { this.key = key; this.value = value; this.hash = hash; }
    }
    private final Node<K, V>[] buckets;
    private final int capacity;
    private Node<K, V> first, last; // MRU -> LRU
    private int size;
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") public LruCache(int capacity) {
        if (capacity < 0 || capacity > (1 << 28)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity out of teaching range");
        this.capacity = capacity;
        int length = 1;
        while (length < Math.max(1, 2 * capacity)) length <<= 1;
        buckets = (Node<K, V>[]) new Node<?, ?>[length];
    }
    private int hash(K key) {
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key");
        int h = key.hashCode(); return h ^ (h >>> 16);
    }
    private Node<K, V> find(K key, int hash) {
        for (Node<K, V> node = buckets[hash & (buckets.length - 1)]; node != null; node = node.bucketNext)
            if (node.hash == hash && key.equals(node.key)) return node;
        return null;
    }
    private void unlinkAccess(Node<K, V> node) {
        if (node.previous == null) first = node.next; else node.previous.next = node.next;
        if (node.next == null) last = node.previous; else node.next.previous = node.previous;
        node.previous = node.next = null;
    }
    private void linkFirst(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.next = first;
        if (first != null) first.previous = node; else last = node;
        first = node;
    }
    private void touch(Node<K, V> node) { unlinkAccess(node); linkFirst(node); }
    private void remove(Node<K, V> node) {
        int bucket = node.hash & (buckets.length - 1);
        if (node.bucketPrevious == null) buckets[bucket] = node.bucketNext;
        else node.bucketPrevious.bucketNext = node.bucketNext;
        if (node.bucketNext != null) node.bucketNext.bucketPrevious = node.bucketPrevious;
        node.bucketPrevious = null;
        unlinkAccess(node); node.bucketNext = null; size--;
    }
    public synchronized V get(K key) {
        Node<K, V> node = find(key, hash(key));
        if (node == null) return null;
        touch(node); return node.value;
    }
    public synchronized void put(K key, V value) {
        int hash = hash(key);
        if (value == null) throw new NullPointerException("value");
        Node<K, V> node = find(key, hash);
        if (node != null) { node.value = value; touch(node); return; }
        if (capacity == 0) return;
        Node<K, V> fresh = new Node<>(key, value, hash); // Allocate before evicting an existing value.
        if (size == capacity) remove(last);
        int bucket = hash & (buckets.length - 1);
        fresh.bucketNext = buckets[bucket];
        if (fresh.bucketNext != null) fresh.bucketNext.bucketPrevious = fresh;
        buckets[bucket] = fresh;
        linkFirst(fresh); size++;
    }
    public synchronized int evict(int n) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("n >= 0");
        int removed = 0;
        while (removed < n && last != null) { remove(last); removed++; }
        return removed;
    }
    public synchronized int size() { return size; }
    public synchronized Object[] keysMostRecentFirst() {
        Object[] keys = new Object[size]; int i = 0;
        for (Node<K, V> node = first; node != null; node = node.next) keys[i++] = node.key;
        if (i != size) throw new AssertionError("access-list invariant");
        return keys;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        LruCache<Integer, String> cache = new LruCache<>(2);
        cache.put(1, "a"); cache.put(2, "b"); Checks.that(cache.get(1).equals("a"), "hit touches");
        cache.put(3, "c"); Checks.that(cache.get(2) == null, "LRU eviction");
        cache.put(1, "A"); Checks.that(cache.size() == 2 && cache.get(1).equals("A"), "update no size growth");
        Checks.that(cache.evict(10) == 2 && cache.size() == 0, "evict beyond size");
        LruCache<Integer, Integer> zero = new LruCache<>(0); zero.put(1, 1);
        Checks.that(zero.get(1) == null && zero.size() == 0, "zero capacity");
        record Collision(int id) { public int hashCode() { return 1; } }
        LruCache<Collision, Integer> collided = new LruCache<>(3);
        for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) collided.put(new Collision(n), n);
        Checks.that(collided.get(new Collision(9)) == 9 && collided.get(new Collision(6)) == null, "bucket collisions");
        LruCache<Integer, Integer> shared = new LruCache<>(32); ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4);
        try {
            List<Future<?>> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++) { int base = t * 1000; jobs.add(pool.submit(() -> {
                for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) { shared.put(base + i, i); shared.get(base + i); }
            })); }
            for (Future<?> f : jobs) Checks.get(f);
            Checks.that(shared.size() == 32 && shared.keysMostRecentFirst().length == 32, "concurrent capacity/list invariant");
        } finally { Checks.stop(pool); }
        System.out.println("LruCache OK");
    }
}

过期优先为什么不能只检查 LRU 尾部

TTL 回答“什么时候失效”，LRU 回答“最近谁用过”，两者不能共用同一个顺序。看下面测试的时间线：A 在 0 时写入、10 时过期，B 在 5 时写入、15 时过期；9 时读取 A 会把它移到最近使用的头部，却不续期。

到 10 时插入 C，应该先删已过期的 A。若只检查 LRU 尾部，看到的却是仍有效的 B，可能错删 B、留下头部已经过期的 A。这就是不能只按访问顺序判断过期的原因。

本答案设定所有写入共享一个 TTL，读取不续期，更新写入重新计算期限，now 等于 expires 时视为已过期。get 发现自身过期就删除并返回空；put 先通过独立过期索引删除所有到期条目，仍满时才淘汰活的 LRU。若题目只给“带 TTL 的 LRU”，续期方式、惰性还是定时清理、过期优先和线程安全要逐项确认，不要默认全部成立。

这里用 TreeSet 按期限及唯一序号排序，哈希和手写双向访问链表分别保留查找与 LRU 语义。相同期限必须能保存多个节点；更新期限前先从有序索引移除，修改后重新加入。与不断塞入过期堆而留下陈旧节点相比，这种实现的辅助索引始终与物理条目数同阶。

加入 TTL 索引后，删除和更新变为 O(log n)，清理 k 个到期项为 O(k log n)，不能继续声称所有操作 O(1)。若只要求惰性删除且允许插入时扫描全表，也能写更简单的版本，但必须承认扫描成本。若要求严格 O(1) 并且统一写 TTL，可讨论独立写入时间队列和版本淘汰；更新、内存回收和最坏清理批次仍要分析。

测试时使用可控单调时钟，不靠 sleep 碰过期边界。示例时钟单位由调用者统一，要求从非负相对时间起步且单调；真实系统可封装 nanoTime 的相对差值，不能把系统墙钟调整当成业务时间倒流。

code/TtlLruCache.java

code/TtlLruCache.java
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

/** Common write TTL, no read renewal; expiry index is independent of recency. */
public final class TtlLruCache<K, V> {
    private static final class Node<K, V> {
        final K key; final long sequence; V value; long expires;
        Node<K, V> previous, next;
        Node(K key, V value, long expires, long sequence) {
            this.key = key; this.value = value; this.expires = expires; this.sequence = sequence;
        }
    }
    private final int capacity;
    private final long ttl;
    private final LongSupplier clock;
    private final Map<K, Node<K, V>> map = new HashMap<>();
    private final NavigableSet<Node<K, V>> expiry = new TreeSet<>(
            Comparator.<Node<K, V>>comparingLong(n -> n.expires).thenComparingLong(n -> n.sequence));
    private Node<K, V> first, last;
    private long sequence, lastTime;
    public TtlLruCache(int capacity, long ttlTicks, LongSupplier monotonicNonnegativeClock) {
        if (capacity < 0 || ttlTicks <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        this.capacity = capacity; ttl = ttlTicks; clock = Objects.requireNonNull(monotonicNonnegativeClock);
    }
    private long now() {
        long value = clock.getAsLong();
        if (value < lastTime) throw new IllegalStateException("clock must be nonnegative and monotonic");
        lastTime = value; return value;
    }
    private void unlink(Node<K, V> node) {
        if (node.previous == null) first = node.next; else node.previous.next = node.next;
        if (node.next == null) last = node.previous; else node.next.previous = node.previous;
        node.previous = node.next = null;
    }
    private void front(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.next = first;
        if (first == null) last = node; else first.previous = node;
        first = node;
    }
    private void remove(Node<K, V> node) { map.remove(node.key); expiry.remove(node); unlink(node); }
    private void purge(long time) {
        while (!expiry.isEmpty() && expiry.first().expires <= time) remove(expiry.first());
    }
    public synchronized V get(K key) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(key); long time = now(); Node<K, V> node = map.get(key);
        if (node == null) return null;
        if (node.expires <= time) { remove(node); return null; }
        unlink(node); front(node); return node.value;
    }
    public synchronized void put(K key, V value) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(key); Objects.requireNonNull(value);
        long time = now(), expires = Math.addExact(time, ttl);
        long newSequence = Math.incrementExact(sequence);
        purge(time); // Remove expired entries anywhere in the recency list before evicting live LRU.
        Node<K, V> node = map.get(key);
        if (node != null) {
            expiry.remove(node); node.expires = expires; node.value = value;
            expiry.add(node); unlink(node); front(node); return;
        }
        if (capacity == 0) return;
        Node<K, V> fresh = new Node<>(key, value, expires, newSequence);
        if (map.size() == capacity) remove(last);
        sequence = newSequence; map.put(key, fresh); expiry.add(fresh); front(fresh);
    }
    public synchronized int evict(int n) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        int removed = 0;
        while (removed < n && last != null) { remove(last); removed++; }
        return removed;
    }
    /** A physical entry count; expired entries may remain until touched or a put purges them. */
    public synchronized int retainedSize() { return map.size(); }

        long[] clock = {0}; TtlLruCache<String, Integer> cache = new TtlLruCache<>(2, 10, () -> clock[0]);
        cache.put("A", 1); clock[0] = 5; cache.put("B", 2);

        Checks.that(cache.get("C") == null && cache.get("B") == 22, "put renews, expiration is exclusive");
        Checks.that(cache.evict(100) == 1 && cache.retainedSize() == 0, "eviction removes both indices");

        sameExpiry.put("x", 1); sameExpiry.put("y", 2); sameExpiry.put("z", 3);

        try { cache.put("overflow", 4); throw new AssertionError("deadline overflow accepted"); }
        catch (ArithmeticException expected) { }

范围查询 分布式和 ACM 输入输出

按 key 范围查询需要有序索引，仅靠哈希表不能高效完成。可以加入 TreeMap 或跳表，把单键与范围查询、访问链表、过期索引放在同一一致性边界；通常单键更新成本上升到 O(log n)。若要求“有序且线程安全 Map”，先问有序是插入顺序、访问顺序还是键排序，三者对应不同结构。

分布式 LRU 可以按一致性哈希分片，每片维护自己的容量与淘汰策略，但它不是全局严格 LRU。扩缩容要考虑迁移、双写或转发、一致性和过期时间；热点 key 仍可能集中打满一个节点，需要热点复制、请求合并、本地缓存或限流，并明确一致性代价。单 JVM 加锁无法跨节点保护状态。

ACM 模式还要求解析具体输入并按题面输出；原题若未提供操作编码和输入格式，应先确认，不应凭空给它编一个唯一规范。下面给出可运行教学入口，明确采用首行 capacity，后续 GET key、PUT key value、EVICT n，值和键为无空格字符串，GET 未命中输出 NULL，EVICT 输出实际删除数。

17 从普通 LRU 到泛型 并发 TTL 和分布式

手写 LRU 为什么同时需要哈希和双向链表

哈希索引负责按 key 定位节点，双向链表负责按最近访问顺序移动和淘汰；命中 get 和更新 put 都会改变访问顺序，因此线程安全版本的 get 也不是纯读操作。头部放最近使用项，尾部放最久未使用项，满容量插入时同时删除尾节点及其哈希映射。

如果明确禁止 LinkedHashMap，就不能用它隐藏链表实现。下面还把哈希桶自己实现出来，使严格手写变体也有完整答案；泛型键值均不接受 null，容量可以为零，get 未命中返回 null，evict(n) 删除最多 n 个尾节点并返回实际数量，负 n 抛错。

查找 O(1) 是散列分布合理时的期望复杂度，碰撞严重时可退化，不应宣称任意键都严格常数时间。桶内也维护前驱指针，已知尾节点的删除不必再次遍历碰撞链，所以 evict(n) 的结构修改是 O(min(n,size))。固定桶数组按容量预分配，避免访问过程中扩容；因此空间为 O(capacity)，不适合无上界容量或超大稀疏配置。

全局 synchronized 让哈希和访问链表保持一致，代价是同一缓存操作串行；键的 hashCode/equals 必须稳定、无重入副作用，返回的可变 value 仍由调用者管理。分段锁可以提高分区并发，但若每段独立淘汰，得到的是分段近似 LRU，不再是全局严格 LRU。

code/LruCache.java

code/LruCache.java
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/** Handwritten hash buckets + doubly linked access list; no LinkedHashMap/HashMap inside the cache. */
public final class LruCache<K, V> {
    private static final class Node<K, V> {
        final K key; final int hash; V value;
        Node<K, V> bucketPrevious, bucketNext, previous, next;
        Node(K key, V value, int hash) { this.key = key; this.value = value; this.hash = hash; }
    }
    private final Node<K, V>[] buckets;
    private final int capacity;
    private Node<K, V> first, last; // MRU -> LRU
    private int size;
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") public LruCache(int capacity) {
        if (capacity < 0 || capacity > (1 << 28)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity out of teaching range");
        this.capacity = capacity;
        int length = 1;
        while (length < Math.max(1, 2 * capacity)) length <<= 1;
        buckets = (Node<K, V>[]) new Node<?, ?>[length];
    }
    private int hash(K key) {
        if (key == null) throw new NullPointerException("key");
        int h = key.hashCode(); return h ^ (h >>> 16);
    }
    private Node<K, V> find(K key, int hash) {
        for (Node<K, V> node = buckets[hash & (buckets.length - 1)]; node != null; node = node.bucketNext)
            if (node.hash == hash && key.equals(node.key)) return node;
        return null;
    }
    private void unlinkAccess(Node<K, V> node) {
        if (node.previous == null) first = node.next; else node.previous.next = node.next;
        if (node.next == null) last = node.previous; else node.next.previous = node.previous;
        node.previous = node.next = null;
    }
    private void linkFirst(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.next = first;
        if (first != null) first.previous = node; else last = node;
        first = node;
    }
    private void touch(Node<K, V> node) { unlinkAccess(node); linkFirst(node); }
    private void remove(Node<K, V> node) {
        int bucket = node.hash & (buckets.length - 1);
        if (node.bucketPrevious == null) buckets[bucket] = node.bucketNext;
        else node.bucketPrevious.bucketNext = node.bucketNext;
        if (node.bucketNext != null) node.bucketNext.bucketPrevious = node.bucketPrevious;
        node.bucketPrevious = null;
        unlinkAccess(node); node.bucketNext = null; size--;
    }
    public synchronized V get(K key) {
        Node<K, V> node = find(key, hash(key));
        if (node == null) return null;
        touch(node); return node.value;
    }
    public synchronized void put(K key, V value) {
        int hash = hash(key);
        if (value == null) throw new NullPointerException("value");
        Node<K, V> node = find(key, hash);
        if (node != null) { node.value = value; touch(node); return; }
        if (capacity == 0) return;
        Node<K, V> fresh = new Node<>(key, value, hash); // Allocate before evicting an existing value.
        if (size == capacity) remove(last);
        int bucket = hash & (buckets.length - 1);
        fresh.bucketNext = buckets[bucket];
        if (fresh.bucketNext != null) fresh.bucketNext.bucketPrevious = fresh;
        buckets[bucket] = fresh;
        linkFirst(fresh); size++;
    }
    public synchronized int evict(int n) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("n >= 0");
        int removed = 0;
        while (removed < n && last != null) { remove(last); removed++; }
        return removed;
    }
    public synchronized int size() { return size; }
    public synchronized Object[] keysMostRecentFirst() {
        Object[] keys = new Object[size]; int i = 0;
        for (Node<K, V> node = first; node != null; node = node.next) keys[i++] = node.key;
        if (i != size) throw new AssertionError("access-list invariant");
        return keys;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        LruCache<Integer, String> cache = new LruCache<>(2);
        cache.put(1, "a"); cache.put(2, "b"); Checks.that(cache.get(1).equals("a"), "hit touches");
        cache.put(3, "c"); Checks.that(cache.get(2) == null, "LRU eviction");
        cache.put(1, "A"); Checks.that(cache.size() == 2 && cache.get(1).equals("A"), "update no size growth");
        Checks.that(cache.evict(10) == 2 && cache.size() == 0, "evict beyond size");
        LruCache<Integer, Integer> zero = new LruCache<>(0); zero.put(1, 1);
        Checks.that(zero.get(1) == null && zero.size() == 0, "zero capacity");
        record Collision(int id) { public int hashCode() { return 1; } }
        LruCache<Collision, Integer> collided = new LruCache<>(3);
        for (int n = 0; n < 10; n++) collided.put(new Collision(n), n);
        Checks.that(collided.get(new Collision(9)) == 9 && collided.get(new Collision(6)) == null, "bucket collisions");
        LruCache<Integer, Integer> shared = new LruCache<>(32); ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4);
        try {
            List<Future<?>> jobs = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int t = 0; t < 4; t++) { int base = t * 1000; jobs.add(pool.submit(() -> {
                for (int i = 0; i < 1000; i++) { shared.put(base + i, i); shared.get(base + i); }
            })); }
            for (Future<?> f : jobs) Checks.get(f);
            Checks.that(shared.size() == 32 && shared.keysMostRecentFirst().length == 32, "concurrent capacity/list invariant");
        } finally { Checks.stop(pool); }
        System.out.println("LruCache OK");
    }
}

过期优先为什么不能只检查 LRU 尾部

TTL 回答“什么时候失效”，LRU 回答“最近谁用过”，两者不能共用同一个顺序。看下面测试的时间线：A 在 0 时写入、10 时过期，B 在 5 时写入、15 时过期；9 时读取 A 会把它移到最近使用的头部，却不续期。

到 10 时插入 C，应该先删已过期的 A。若只检查 LRU 尾部，看到的却是仍有效的 B，可能错删 B、留下头部已经过期的 A。这就是不能只按访问顺序判断过期的原因。

本答案设定所有写入共享一个 TTL，读取不续期，更新写入重新计算期限，now 等于 expires 时视为已过期。get 发现自身过期就删除并返回空；put 先通过独立过期索引删除所有到期条目，仍满时才淘汰活的 LRU。若题目只给“带 TTL 的 LRU”，续期方式、惰性还是定时清理、过期优先和线程安全要逐项确认，不要默认全部成立。

这里用 TreeSet 按期限及唯一序号排序，哈希和手写双向访问链表分别保留查找与 LRU 语义。相同期限必须能保存多个节点；更新期限前先从有序索引移除，修改后重新加入。与不断塞入过期堆而留下陈旧节点相比，这种实现的辅助索引始终与物理条目数同阶。

加入 TTL 索引后，删除和更新变为 O(log n)，清理 k 个到期项为 O(k log n)，不能继续声称所有操作 O(1)。若只要求惰性删除且允许插入时扫描全表，也能写更简单的版本，但必须承认扫描成本。若要求严格 O(1) 并且统一写 TTL，可讨论独立写入时间队列和版本淘汰；更新、内存回收和最坏清理批次仍要分析。

测试时使用可控单调时钟，不靠 sleep 碰过期边界。示例时钟单位由调用者统一，要求从非负相对时间起步且单调；真实系统可封装 nanoTime 的相对差值，不能把系统墙钟调整当成业务时间倒流。

code/TtlLruCache.java

code/TtlLruCache.java
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

/** Common write TTL, no read renewal; expiry index is independent of recency. */
public final class TtlLruCache<K, V> {
    private static final class Node<K, V> {
        final K key; final long sequence; V value; long expires;
        Node<K, V> previous, next;
        Node(K key, V value, long expires, long sequence) {
            this.key = key; this.value = value; this.expires = expires; this.sequence = sequence;
        }
    }
    private final int capacity;
    private final long ttl;
    private final LongSupplier clock;
    private final Map<K, Node<K, V>> map = new HashMap<>();
    private final NavigableSet<Node<K, V>> expiry = new TreeSet<>(
            Comparator.<Node<K, V>>comparingLong(n -> n.expires).thenComparingLong(n -> n.sequence));
    private Node<K, V> first, last;
    private long sequence, lastTime;
    public TtlLruCache(int capacity, long ttlTicks, LongSupplier monotonicNonnegativeClock) {
        if (capacity < 0 || ttlTicks <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        this.capacity = capacity; ttl = ttlTicks; clock = Objects.requireNonNull(monotonicNonnegativeClock);
    }
    private long now() {
        long value = clock.getAsLong();
        if (value < lastTime) throw new IllegalStateException("clock must be nonnegative and monotonic");
        lastTime = value; return value;
    }
    private void unlink(Node<K, V> node) {
        if (node.previous == null) first = node.next; else node.previous.next = node.next;
        if (node.next == null) last = node.previous; else node.next.previous = node.previous;
        node.previous = node.next = null;
    }
    private void front(Node<K, V> node) {
        node.next = first;
        if (first == null) last = node; else first.previous = node;
        first = node;
    }
    private void remove(Node<K, V> node) { map.remove(node.key); expiry.remove(node); unlink(node); }
    private void purge(long time) {
        while (!expiry.isEmpty() && expiry.first().expires <= time) remove(expiry.first());
    }
    public synchronized V get(K key) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(key); long time = now(); Node<K, V> node = map.get(key);
        if (node == null) return null;
        if (node.expires <= time) { remove(node); return null; }
        unlink(node); front(node); return node.value;
    }
    public synchronized void put(K key, V value) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(key); Objects.requireNonNull(value);
        long time = now(), expires = Math.addExact(time, ttl);
        long newSequence = Math.incrementExact(sequence);
        purge(time); // Remove expired entries anywhere in the recency list before evicting live LRU.
        Node<K, V> node = map.get(key);
        if (node != null) {
            expiry.remove(node); node.expires = expires; node.value = value;
            expiry.add(node); unlink(node); front(node); return;
        }
        if (capacity == 0) return;
        Node<K, V> fresh = new Node<>(key, value, expires, newSequence);
        if (map.size() == capacity) remove(last);
        sequence = newSequence; map.put(key, fresh); expiry.add(fresh); front(fresh);
    }
    public synchronized int evict(int n) {
        if (n < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
        int removed = 0;
        while (removed < n && last != null) { remove(last); removed++; }
        return removed;
    }
    /** A physical entry count; expired entries may remain until touched or a put purges them. */
    public synchronized int retainedSize() { return map.size(); }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        long[] clock = {0}; TtlLruCache<String, Integer> cache = new TtlLruCache<>(2, 10, () -> clock[0]);
        cache.put("A", 1); clock[0] = 5; cache.put("B", 2);
        clock[0] = 9; Checks.that(cache.get("A") == 1, "A becomes MRU without renewing TTL");
        clock[0] = 10; cache.put("C", 3);
        Checks.that(cache.get("A") == null && cache.get("B") == 2 && cache.get("C") == 3,
                "expired MRU removed before live LRU");
        clock[0] = 14; cache.put("B", 22); clock[0] = 20;
        Checks.that(cache.get("C") == null && cache.get("B") == 22, "put renews, expiration is exclusive");
        Checks.that(cache.evict(100) == 1 && cache.retainedSize() == 0, "eviction removes both indices");
        TtlLruCache<String, Integer> sameExpiry = new TtlLruCache<>(3, 10, () -> 0);
        sameExpiry.put("x", 1); sameExpiry.put("y", 2); sameExpiry.put("z", 3);
        Checks.that(sameExpiry.retainedSize() == 3, "equal expiry nodes coexist");
        clock[0] = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        try { cache.put("overflow", 4); throw new AssertionError("deadline overflow accepted"); }
        catch (ArithmeticException expected) { }
        Checks.that(cache.retainedSize() == 0, "overflow before structural change");
        System.out.println("TtlLruCache OK");
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.TreeMap;

public class MemoryAllocator {
    private final TreeMap<Integer, Integer> blocks = new TreeMap<>();

    public MemoryAllocator(String config) {
        for (String item : config.split(",")) {
            String[] pair = item.split(":");
            int size = Integer.parseInt(pair[0]);
            int count = Integer.parseInt(pair[1]);
            blocks.merge(size, count, Integer::sum);
        }
    }

    public List<Boolean> allocate(List<Integer> requests) {
        List<Boolean> result = new ArrayList<>(requests.size());
        for (int request : requests) {
            Integer size = blocks.ceilingKey(request);
            if (size == null) {
                result.add(false);
                continue;
            }
            result.add(true);
            int count = blocks.get(size);
            if (count == 1) {
                blocks.remove(size);
            } else {
                blocks.put(size, count - 1);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
}

import java.util.*;

/** A stock simulator: blocks are indivisible and are never released in this problem. */
public final class MemoryAllocator {
    private final TreeMap<Long, Integer> stock = new TreeMap<>();
    public MemoryAllocator(String specification) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(specification);
        TreeMap<Long, Integer> parsed = new TreeMap<>();
        if (!specification.trim().isEmpty()) {
            for (String token : specification.split(",", -1)) {
                String[] kv = token.trim().split(":", -1);
                if (kv.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("expected size:count");
                long size = Long.parseLong(kv[0].trim());
                int count = Integer.parseInt(kv[1].trim());
                if (size <= 0 || count < 0 || count > 4096)
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid size/count");
                int merged = parsed.getOrDefault(size, 0) + count;
                if (merged > 4096) throw new IllegalArgumentException("stock per size > 4096");
                parsed.put(size, merged); // Merge duplicates instead of silently overwriting.
                if (parsed.size() > 1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("too many sizes");
            }
        }
        for (Map.Entry<Long, Integer> e : parsed.entrySet())
            if (e.getValue() > 0) stock.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());
    }
    public synchronized boolean allocate(long requested) {
        if (requested <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("request must be positive");
        Map.Entry<Long, Integer> best = stock.ceilingEntry(requested);
        if (best == null) return false;
        long size = best.getKey(); int count = best.getValue();
        if (count == 1) stock.remove(size); else stock.put(size, count - 1);
        return true;
    }
    public static String solve(String pool, String requestLine) {
        MemoryAllocator allocator = new MemoryAllocator(pool);
        Objects.requireNonNull(requestLine);
        if (requestLine.trim().isEmpty()) return "";
        String[] tokens = requestLine.split(",", -1);
        if (tokens.length > 100000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("too many requests");
        long[] requests = new long[tokens.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
            requests[i] = Long.parseLong(tokens[i].trim());
            if (requests[i] <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid request");
        }
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        for (long requested : requests) {
            if (result.length() > 0) result.append(',');
            result.append(allocator.allocate(requested));
        }
        return result.toString();
    }

题意、约束与例子

给出多种“块大小:库存数量”，逐个处理申请。每次分配一个大小≥申请量的最小可用块，整块消耗，不拆分，不归还。最多 1024 种大小，每种总库存≤4096，申请数≤100000；实现采用正 long 表示大小和申请量，库存允许 0，但不放入可用索引。

为什么是 TreeMap ceilingEntry

TreeMap 按大小排序，ceilingEntry(r) 返回最小的 size≥r。索引只保留正库存大小；找到一个块就将库存减一，减为零则删除整个键。它直接表达题目指定的 best-fit 规则，不需要扫描全部 1024 类，也不需要给每个物理块都建一个对象。

追问与测试

- 允许拆分时，64 分配 50 后剩余 14 可以按规则返还索引；这是另一道题。要做真实地址合并，必须记录块起始地址和邻接关系，只有大小计数不够判断两个块是否相邻。

- 固定 2 的幂分级可用位运算找到目标等级，但如果该等级缺货，还需要寻找更高的非空等级；只有配合位图等数据结构才可能保持小常数/常数级查找，不能把一次 leadingZeros 当成完整分配器。

First Fit 从所选索引顺序中取第一个能满足请求的块，查找成本受布局和索引影响；Best Fit 取最小可用块，倾向保留大块；Worst Fit 取最大块，剩余可能较大但也消耗大块储备。允许拆分时它们产生的外部碎片取决于工作负载，不能给普遍优劣排名。本题不可拆分，比较不能改变规定的 best-fit 策略。

public final class SingletonExamples {
    private SingletonExamples() {}
    public static final class Eager {
        private static final Eager INSTANCE = new Eager();
        private Eager() {}
        public static Eager getInstance() { return INSTANCE; }
    }
    public static final class StaticBlock {
        private static final StaticBlock INSTANCE;
        static { INSTANCE = new StaticBlock(); }
        private StaticBlock() {}
        public static StaticBlock getInstance() { return INSTANCE; }
    }
    public enum EnumSingle { INSTANCE }
    public static final class SynchronizedLazy {
        private static SynchronizedLazy instance;
        private SynchronizedLazy() {}
        public static synchronized SynchronizedLazy getInstance() {
            if (instance == null) instance = new SynchronizedLazy();
            return instance;
        }
    }
    public static final class DoubleChecked {
        private static volatile DoubleChecked instance;
        private int initializedValue; // Intentionally non-final: publication matters.
        private DoubleChecked() { initializedValue = 42; }
        public static DoubleChecked getInstance() {
            DoubleChecked local = instance;
            if (local == null) {
                synchronized (DoubleChecked.class) {
                    local = instance;
                    if (local == null) {
                        local = new DoubleChecked();
                        instance = local;
                    }
                }
            }
            return local;
        }
        public int initializedValue() { return initializedValue; }
    }
    public static final class HolderSingle {
        private HolderSingle() {}
        private static final class Holder {
            private static final HolderSingle INSTANCE = new HolderSingle();
        }
        public static HolderSingle getInstance() { return Holder.INSTANCE; }
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;

public final class PatternExamples {
    private PatternExamples() {}

    // Simple factory: a named creation point, not GoF Factory Method by itself.
    public interface Message { String render(String body); }
    public static final class PlainMessage implements Message {
        public String render(String body) { return Objects.requireNonNull(body); }
    }
    public static final class TaggedMessage implements Message {
        public String render(String body) { return "[notice] " + Objects.requireNonNull(body); }
    }
    public static Message simpleFactory(String kind) {
        return switch (Objects.requireNonNull(kind)) {
            case "plain" -> new PlainMessage();
            case "tagged" -> new TaggedMessage();
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown kind: " + kind);
        };
    }
    // Factory Method: subclasses supply a product used by a stable workflow.
    public abstract static class MessageJob {
        protected abstract Message createMessage();
        public final String execute(String body) {
            return createMessage().render(Objects.requireNonNull(body));
        }
    }
    public static final class PlainJob extends MessageJob {
        protected Message createMessage() { return new PlainMessage(); }
    }
    public static final class TaggedJob extends MessageJob {
        protected Message createMessage() { return new TaggedMessage(); }
    }
    // Abstract Factory: choose a family, then create related product types.
    public interface Chair { String style(); }
    public interface Table { String style(); }
    public interface FurnitureFactory { Chair chair(); Table table(); }
    public static final class ModernFactory implements FurnitureFactory {
        public Chair chair() { return () -> "modern"; }
        public Table table() { return () -> "modern"; }
    }
    public static final class ClassicFactory implements FurnitureFactory {
        public Chair chair() { return () -> "classic"; }
        public Table table() { return () -> "classic"; }
    }

    public enum Tier { NORMAL, VIP }
    public interface PricePolicy { long quote(long cents); }
    public static final class PriceService {
        private final Map<Tier, PricePolicy> policies;
        public PriceService(Map<Tier, PricePolicy> policies) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(policies);
            EnumMap<Tier, PricePolicy> copy = new EnumMap<>(Tier.class);
            policies.forEach((k, v) -> copy.put(Objects.requireNonNull(k), Objects.requireNonNull(v)));
            this.policies = Collections.unmodifiableMap(copy);
        }
        public long quote(Tier tier, long cents) {
            if (cents < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative amount");
            PricePolicy p = policies.get(Objects.requireNonNull(tier));
            if (p == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("No policy for " + tier);
            long result = p.quote(cents);
            if (result < 0 || result > cents) throw new IllegalStateException("invalid discount");
            return result;
        }
    }

    public record Content(String text, boolean authenticated) {
        public Content { Objects.requireNonNull(text); }
    }
    public record Decision(boolean accepted, String reason) {
        public Decision { Objects.requireNonNull(reason); }
        public static Decision pass() { return new Decision(true, "accepted"); }
        public static Decision reject(String why) { return new Decision(false, why); }
    }
    public interface Rule { Optional<String> rejection(Content content); }
    public static final class ReviewChain {
        private final List<Rule> rules;
        public ReviewChain(List<Rule> rules) {
            this.rules = List.copyOf(rules);
            if (this.rules.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty review chain");
        }
        public Decision review(Content content) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(content);
            for (Rule rule : rules) {
                Optional<String> rejection = Objects.requireNonNull(rule.rejection(content));
                if (rejection.isPresent()) return Decision.reject(rejection.get());
            }
            return Decision.pass();
        }
    }

    // Template Method: keep the primary throwable, including shared exception instances.
    public interface Resource extends AutoCloseable {
        @Override void close() throws Exception;
    }
    public abstract static class ImportJob {
        protected abstract Resource open() throws Exception;
        protected abstract int doImport(Resource resource) throws Exception;
        public final int run() throws Exception {
            Resource resource = Objects.requireNonNull(open());
            Throwable primary = null;
            try {
                return doImport(resource);
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                primary = failure;
                throw failure;
            } finally {
                if (primary == null) {
                    resource.close();
                } else {
                    try {
                        resource.close();
                    } catch (Throwable closing) {
                        if (closing != primary) primary.addSuppressed(closing);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public interface TextService { String read(String key); }
    public static final class UpperCaseDecorator implements TextService {
        private final TextService next;
        public UpperCaseDecorator(TextService next) { this.next = Objects.requireNonNull(next); }
        public String read(String key) { return next.read(key).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT); }
    }
    public static final class PrefixDecorator implements TextService {
        private final TextService next;
        private final String prefix;
        public PrefixDecorator(TextService next, String prefix) {
            this.next = Objects.requireNonNull(next);
            this.prefix = Objects.requireNonNull(prefix);
        }
        public String read(String key) { return prefix + next.read(key); }
    }
    public static final class GuardProxy implements TextService {
        private final TextService target;
        private final BooleanSupplier allowed;
        public GuardProxy(TextService target, BooleanSupplier allowed) {
            this.target = Objects.requireNonNull(target);
            this.allowed = Objects.requireNonNull(allowed);
        }
        public String read(String key) {
            if (!allowed.getAsBoolean()) throw new SecurityException("denied");
            return target.read(key);
        }
    }
    public interface LegacyLookup { String find(int id); }
    public static final class LookupAdapter implements TextService {
        private final LegacyLookup legacy;
        public LookupAdapter(LegacyLookup legacy) { this.legacy = Objects.requireNonNull(legacy); }
        public String read(String key) { return legacy.find(Integer.parseInt(key)); }
    }
}

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

// Thread-confined synchronous bus. It is intentionally not a concurrent broker.
public final class EventBus<E> {
    public interface Subscription extends AutoCloseable { @Override void close(); }
    private final Thread owner = Thread.currentThread();
    private final Map<String, LinkedHashSet<Entry>> topics = new HashMap<>();
    private final class Entry implements Subscription {
        final String topic;
        final LinkedHashSet<Entry> group;
        final Consumer<? super E> listener;
        final boolean once;
        boolean active = true;
        Entry(String topic, LinkedHashSet<Entry> group,
              Consumer<? super E> listener, boolean once) {
            this.topic = topic; this.group = group; this.listener = listener; this.once = once;
        }
        public void close() {
            checkThread();
            active = false;
            group.remove(this);
            if (group.isEmpty() && topics.get(topic) == group) topics.remove(topic);
        }
    }
    private void checkThread() {
        if (Thread.currentThread() != owner) throw new IllegalStateException("wrong thread");
    }
    public Subscription on(String topic, Consumer<? super E> listener, boolean once) {
        checkThread();
        Objects.requireNonNull(topic); Objects.requireNonNull(listener);
        LinkedHashSet<Entry> group = topics.computeIfAbsent(topic, ignored -> new LinkedHashSet<>());
        Entry entry = new Entry(topic, group, listener, once);
        group.add(entry);
        return entry;
    }
    public int emit(String topic, E event) {
        checkThread(); Objects.requireNonNull(topic);
        LinkedHashSet<Entry> group = topics.get(topic);
        if (group == null) return 0;
        List<Entry> snapshot = new ArrayList<>(group);
        int called = 0;
        for (Entry entry : snapshot) {
            if (!entry.active) continue;
            if (entry.once) entry.close();
            entry.listener.accept(event); // fail fast; subsequent listeners are not called
            called++;
        }
        return called;
    }
}

export class EventBus {
  #topics = new Map();
  on(topic, fn, { once = false } = {}) {
    if (typeof fn !== 'function') throw new TypeError('listener must be a function');
    let entries = this.#topics.get(topic);
    if (!entries) this.#topics.set(topic, entries = new Set());
    const entry = { fn, once, active: true };
    entries.add(entry);
    const off = () => {
      entry.active = false;
      entries.delete(entry);
      if (!entries.size && this.#topics.get(topic) === entries) this.#topics.delete(topic);
    };
    entry.off = off;
    return off;
  }
  emit(topic, payload) {
    const snapshot = [...(this.#topics.get(topic) ?? [])];
    let called = 0;
    for (const entry of snapshot) {
      if (!entry.active) continue;
      if (entry.once) entry.off();
      entry.fn(payload);
      called++;
    }
    return called;
  }
}

from functools import wraps
from time import perf_counter


def log_call(sink=print, format_args=lambda args, kwargs: "<redacted>"):
    """Synchronous functions only; provide an explicit safe formatter to print arguments."""
    def decorate(fn):
        @wraps(fn)
        def wrapped(*args, **kwargs):
            started = perf_counter()
            try:
                sink(f"{fn.__name__} args={format_args(args, kwargs)}")
                return fn(*args, **kwargs)
            finally:
                sink(f"{fn.__name__} elapsed={perf_counter() - started:.6f}s")
        return wrapped
    return decorate

import java.io.*;
import java.lang.reflect.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.*;
import java.util.function.*;

public final class PatternContractTest {
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean condition, String name) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(name);
    }
    private static void expect(Class<? extends Throwable> type, Runnable action, String name) {
        try { action.run(); } catch (Throwable error) {
            check(type.isInstance(error), name + ": " + error); return;
        }
        throw new AssertionError(name + ": missing error");
    }
    private static void singletonRace(Supplier<Object> get) throws Exception {
        ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(16);
        CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        List<Future<Object>> tasks = new ArrayList<>();
        try {
            for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) tasks.add(pool.submit(() -> { start.await(); return get.get(); }));
            start.countDown();
            Object first = tasks.get(0).get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            for (Future<Object> task : tasks) check(task.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == first, "same identity");
        } finally { pool.shutdownNow(); check(pool.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "pool ended"); }
    }
    private static void singletons() throws Exception {
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.Eager::getInstance);
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.StaticBlock::getInstance);
        singletonRace(() -> SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.INSTANCE);
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.SynchronizedLazy::getInstance);
        singletonRace(() -> {
            SingletonExamples.DoubleChecked value = SingletonExamples.DoubleChecked.getInstance();
            if (value.initializedValue() != 42) throw new AssertionError("unsafe publication");
            return value;
        });
        singletonRace(SingletonExamples.HolderSingle::getInstance);
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (ObjectOutputStream out = new ObjectOutputStream(bytes)) { out.writeObject(SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.INSTANCE); }
        try (ObjectInputStream in = new ObjectInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes.toByteArray()))) {
            check(in.readObject() == SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.INSTANCE, "enum serialization identity");
        }
        Constructor<SingletonExamples.EnumSingle> enumCtor = SingletonExamples.EnumSingle.class.getDeclaredConstructor(String.class, int.class);
        enumCtor.setAccessible(true);
        try { enumCtor.newInstance("FAKE", 1); throw new AssertionError("enum reflection accepted"); }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { check(true, "enum reflection refused"); }
        Constructor<SingletonExamples.HolderSingle> ordinary = SingletonExamples.HolderSingle.class.getDeclaredConstructor();
        ordinary.setAccessible(true);
        check(ordinary.newInstance() != SingletonExamples.HolderSingle.getInstance(), "private ctor is not reflection proof");
        URL base = SingletonExamples.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation();
        try (URLClassLoader left = new URLClassLoader(new URL[]{base}, null);
             URLClassLoader right = new URLClassLoader(new URL[]{base}, null)) {
            Object a = left.loadClass("SingletonExamples$HolderSingle").getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            Object b = right.loadClass("SingletonExamples$HolderSingle").getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            check(a != b && a.getClass() != b.getClass(), "per defining class loader");
        }
    }
    private static void patterns() throws Exception {
        check(PatternExamples.simpleFactory("plain").render("x").equals("x"), "simple factory");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> PatternExamples.simpleFactory("missing"), "unknown factory");
        check(new PatternExamples.TaggedJob().execute("x").equals("[notice] x"), "factory method");
        check(new PatternExamples.PlainJob().execute("x").equals("x"), "factory method alternative");
        for (PatternExamples.FurnitureFactory f : List.of(new PatternExamples.ModernFactory(), new PatternExamples.ClassicFactory()))
            check(f.chair().style().equals(f.table().style()), "compatible product family");
        Map<PatternExamples.Tier, PatternExamples.PricePolicy> input = new EnumMap<>(PatternExamples.Tier.class);
        input.put(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, amount -> amount);
        input.put(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, amount -> amount - amount / 10);
        PatternExamples.PriceService pricing = new PatternExamples.PriceService(input);
        input.clear();
        check(pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, 99) == 99, "immutable selection map");
        check(pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, 99) == 90, "round down discount cents");
        check(pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, Long.MAX_VALUE) == Long.MAX_VALUE - Long.MAX_VALUE / 10, "no multiplication overflow");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> pricing.quote(PatternExamples.Tier.VIP, -1), "negative price");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new PatternExamples.PriceService(Map.of()).quote(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, 1), "missing strategy");
        expect(IllegalStateException.class, () -> new PatternExamples.PriceService(Map.of(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, n -> -1)).quote(PatternExamples.Tier.NORMAL, 1), "broken strategy contract");
        List<String> seen = new ArrayList<>();
        PatternExamples.Rule auth = content -> { seen.add("auth"); return content.authenticated() ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of("auth"); };
        PatternExamples.Rule length = content -> { seen.add("length"); return content.text().length() > 5 ? Optional.of("length") : Optional.empty(); };
        PatternExamples.ReviewChain chain = new PatternExamples.ReviewChain(List.of(auth, length));
        check(!chain.review(new PatternExamples.Content("hi", false)).accepted() && seen.equals(List.of("auth")), "chain stops");
        seen.clear();
        check(chain.review(new PatternExamples.Content("hi", true)).accepted() && seen.equals(List.of("auth", "length")), "chain order");
        check(chain.review(new PatternExamples.Content("123456", true)).reason().equals("length"), "chain rejection reason");
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new PatternExamples.ReviewChain(List.of()), "empty chain rejected");
        AtomicInteger closed = new AtomicInteger();
        PatternExamples.ImportJob job = new PatternExamples.ImportJob() {
            protected PatternExamples.Resource open() { return closed::incrementAndGet; }
            protected int doImport(PatternExamples.Resource resource) { return 7; }
        };
        check(job.run() == 7 && closed.get() == 1, "template closes success");
        PatternExamples.ImportJob failure = new PatternExamples.ImportJob() {
            protected PatternExamples.Resource open() { return () -> { throw new IOException("close"); }; }
            protected int doImport(PatternExamples.Resource resource) throws Exception { throw new IOException("work"); }

        try { failure.run(); throw new AssertionError("failure missing"); }
        catch (IOException e) { check(e.getMessage().equals("work") && e.getSuppressed().length == 1, "template preserves primary error"); }

        AtomicInteger hits = new AtomicInteger();

        expect(SecurityException.class, () -> guard.read("x"), "proxy denied");
        check(hits.get() == 0, "proxy did not call target");

    }
    private static void events() throws Exception {
        EventBus<String> empty = new EventBus<>();
        check(empty.emit("t", "x") == 0, "empty bus");
        EventBus<String> bus = new EventBus<>();
        List<String> events = new ArrayList<>();
        EventBus.Subscription one = bus.on("t", x -> events.add("1" + x), false);
        bus.on("t", x -> events.add("2" + x), false);
        check(bus.emit("t", "x") == 2 && events.equals(List.of("1x", "2x")), "order and payload");
        one.close(); one.close(); events.clear();
        check(bus.emit("t", "y") == 1 && events.equals(List.of("2y")), "idempotent cancel");
        EventBus<Integer> recursive = new EventBus<>();
        AtomicInteger count = new AtomicInteger();
        recursive.on("t", x -> { count.incrementAndGet(); recursive.emit("t", x); }, true);
        recursive.emit("t", 1);
        check(count.get() == 1, "once removed before reentry");
        EventBus<String> cancel = new EventBus<>();
        EventBus.Subscription[] later = new EventBus.Subscription[1];
        cancel.on("t", x -> later[0].close(), false);
        later[0] = cancel.on("t", x -> { throw new AssertionError("canceled called"); }, false);
        check(cancel.emit("t", "x") == 1, "cancel in snapshot");
        EventBus<String> add = new EventBus<>();
        AtomicInteger added = new AtomicInteger();
        add.on("t", x -> add.on("t", y -> added.incrementAndGet(), false), true);
        check(add.emit("t", "x") == 1 && added.get() == 0, "new listener excluded from current snapshot");
        check(add.emit("t", "x") == 1 && added.get() == 1, "new listener participates next time");
        Consumer<String> fn = x -> count.incrementAndGet();
        EventBus<String> dup = new EventBus<>();
        EventBus.Subscription first = dup.on("t", fn, false);
        dup.on("t", fn, false); first.close();
        check(dup.emit("t", "x") == 1, "same function independent registrations");
        EventBus<String> fail = new EventBus<>();
        AtomicInteger after = new AtomicInteger();
        fail.on("t", x -> { throw new IllegalArgumentException("bad"); }, false);
        fail.on("t", x -> after.incrementAndGet(), false);
        expect(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> fail.emit("t", "x"), "fail fast");
        check(after.get() == 0, "later callback not invoked");
        EventBus<String> replace = new EventBus<>();
        EventBus.Subscription old = replace.on("t", x -> {}, false);
        old.close(); replace.on("t", x -> {}, false); old.close();
        check(replace.emit("t", "x") == 1, "old cancel does not remove new group");
        ExecutorService worker = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
        try {
            Future<Boolean> outcome = worker.submit(() -> { try { bus.emit("t", "x"); return false; } catch (IllegalStateException expected) { return true; } });
            check(outcome.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "thread confinement checked");
        } finally { worker.shutdownNow(); check(worker.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "worker ended"); }
    }

        singletons(); patterns(); events();
        System.out.println("PASS PatternContractTest " + checks + " checks");
    }
}

public final class ImportJobBoundaryTest {
    private static int checks;
    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);

            check(job.run() == 7, "success result");
            return null;
        } catch (Throwable failure) {
            return failure;
        }
    }
    private static void caseOf(Exception work, Exception closing, Throwable expected, int suppressed) {
        int[] events = new int[3];
        Throwable actual = run(work, closing, events);
        check(actual == expected, "preserve exception identity");
        check(events[0] == 1 && events[1] == 1 && events[2] == 1, "open/work/close exactly once");
        if (actual != null) {
            check(actual.getSuppressed().length == suppressed, "suppressed count");
            if (suppressed == 1) check(actual.getSuppressed()[0] == closing, "secondary identity");
        }
    }
    private static final class NoSuppression extends Exception {
        NoSuppression() { super("disabled", null, false, true); }
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        caseOf(null, null, null, 0);
        Exception workOnly = new Exception("work");
        caseOf(workOnly, null, workOnly, 0);
        Exception closeOnly = new Exception("close");
        caseOf(null, closeOnly, closeOnly, 0);
        Exception primary = new Exception("primary"), secondary = new Exception("secondary");
        caseOf(primary, secondary, primary, 1);
        Exception shared = new Exception("same instance");
        caseOf(shared, shared, shared, 0);
        Exception disabled = new NoSuppression();
        caseOf(disabled, new Exception("unrecorded secondary"), disabled, 0);
        System.out.println("ImportJobBoundaryTest " + checks + " checks passed");
    }
}
